Local AI: enter the address and model of an Ollama service on your LAN; data never leaves your network.
Online AI: enter any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (DeepSeek / OpenAI / Moonshot / Qwen etc.) with an API key.
Results are saved as "Chinese Title"; pick "Chinese Title" in Advanced → Display Title to show them.

c.guideContent:
■ Getting Started
1. Open http://NAS-IP:10000 in your browser (the port can be changed via the WEB_PORT environment variable).
2. Fill in your ExHentai account cookies (igneous / ipb_pass_hash / ipb_member_id) under Settings → General; proxy is optional.
3. Click "Load Library" on the home page (or press F5) to scan your local manga library; covers and the database are generated automatically. Folders, zip, rar and 7z are supported.
4. Click a cover to open the detail page; click again to enter the built-in reader. The "Read" buttons open the book directly.
5. The app name is customizable (Settings → General → App Name) and shown in the browser tab.

■ Search, Sort & Filter
- The search box supports ExHentai syntax: artist:"xxx", c:character, p:parody, f:female, m:male, language:"english", parody:"xxx" etc. Combine conditions with spaces.
- The sort/filter dropdown offers bookmarked / hidden / recently read filters and sorting by added/modified/uploaded time, rating, read count, artist, title and pages; after picking a sort key, click the ↑/↓ arrow next to it to switch ascending/descending (descending by default).
- "Shuffle" randomizes the order; the folder tree on the left lets you browse by directory.

■ Tags & Metadata
- In the detail page, "Edit Tags" lets you modify tags, status, category and links; "Get Metadata" fetches them from ExHentai automatically.
- Right-click a cover for quick metadata get/reset, move/delete file, copy/paste tags, get metadata from a copied link, etc. Menu items can be customized under Settings → Advanced → Context Menu.
- Settings → Tag Settings: categories on top (click to filter), all library tags below; long-press a tag to collect/uncollect, click the color dot to change its color, ✕ removes it, double-click renames it across the whole library.
- "Show Comments" displays ExHentai comments; metadata can be backed up / restored, and api_dump.sqlite databases can be imported.

■ Collections
- Click "Manage Collections" in the toolbar to enter the collection view: add, edit and reorder collections.

■ Reader
- Single / Double / Scroll modes are supported; the "Switch Viewer" toolbar button toggles between the original and ComicRead viewers; press / in double mode to insert an empty page.
- The thumbnail sidebar jumps to pages quickly; reading progress is saved automatically (can be disabled). Image right-click offers delete, set-as-cover and rename file.
- Scroll mode uses inertia scrolling (Settings → Advanced → Inertia Scroll): it glides after the wheel stops and settles gently at the top/bottom (Off / Gentle / Standard / Strong).

■ AI Features (Settings → AI Features)
- Choose a local Ollama or an online OpenAI-compatible API; the base URL / model / API key are filled separately for each. The model dropdown auto-fetches available models.
- Supports: batch-translate titles to Chinese; batch info processing (title translation + characters + origins + artists + category into metadata, pauseable anytime); character origin lookup; image upscale and text extraction (enable them in settings first).
- Pick "Chinese Title" under Advanced → Display Title to show translations.

■ Interface Customization
- Toolbar buttons can be added/removed and drag-reordered (search and settings buttons are always kept); the search bar stays aligned with the manga cards on a single row.
- Cards can hide title / rating / page count / view count / read buttons / status tag / bookmark star; "Cover Only" shows pure covers. Cover width and card spacing are adjustable (Settings → Advanced → Card Style).
- The theme dropdown offers presets or "Custom Theme": background color, background image, font size/color/style, primary color and website icon.
- Page Size Options lets you customize the pagination dropdown; cards load row by row, so huge page sizes never freeze the UI.
- "Reset All Settings" at the bottom of Advanced restores everything (account / paths / proxy are kept).

■ Docker Web Edition
- Desktop-only features (minimize to tray / start on login / LAN browsing API) are removed in the web edition.
- Default port is 10000 (changeable via WEB_PORT). All data is stored in the mounted /data directory; back up that directory to back everything up.
